verdict.rationale: Edge0 is documented as a local, on-device inference engine that streams weights from SSD and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on localhost. A vendor of this kind could plausibly offer a hosted cloud tier, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions a hosted cloud tier, pricing, rate limits, or usage caps. The 'tier' references (e.g. `--tier edge0-35b`) are model sizes, not pricing tiers, and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
